label: TP
reason: User-provided parameter flows directly into the HTTP response without encoding/neutralization; the doSomething() method only truncates input but does not mitigate XSS risks. The X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly disabled, exacerbating the vulnerability.

evidence.note: Parameter retrieved and passed to doSomething() without initial validation/encoding
doSomething() truncates input but does not prevent XSS; output is directly rendered in response
Unencoded bar variable directly written to response as char array (XSS vector)
